[RFCS.13.3] **The leading atom discriminates the form.** A
`DscHeader` first atom means self-contained (`[DSC][StreamHeader]`); a
`StreamHeader` first atom means lean. A reader must dispatch on the first
atom's `oneof` field number ([RFCS.16.1]), which is its identity — not on
any four-byte prefix. `StreamHeader` must occupy a field number distinct
from every DSC atom's ([RDSC.7.5]) so the boundary is unambiguous
once the DSC's trailing atom is no longer the end of file.
